September 15, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-15-1971-54688

After Iran-Pakistan meeting at Tehran, a bulletin says that Iran shows solidarity with Pakistan.

Pakistan’s UN envoy Aga Shahi entitles India’s envoy Krishna Menon’s urge about western intervention in East Pakistan matter as ‘impudence’, a report from Reuters says.

PDP sits in a meeting chaired by Nurul Amin at his residence. 18 members of the party are present in this meeting. Mahmud Ali is made the president of the party for East Pakistan.
